answers.sql:
SELECT
    ch.CHNL_K,
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON tx.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

-- Count distinct customers who were in default at the end of August 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust
  ON f.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
WHERE f.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
  AND d_dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND d_dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_cust.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(f_rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f_rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_rt.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_rt.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d_ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    d.MKT_K,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MKT_K
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT d_br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br ON f.BR_K = d_br.BR_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_dt.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND d_br.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY d_br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

-- Average closing balance on 30 June 2025
WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT dt_k
  FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
  WHERE cal_dt = '2025-06-30'
),
latest_snapshot AS (
  SELECT f.*
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN target_date t ON f.bus_dt_k = t.dt_k
  WHERE f.snap_tmstm = (
    SELECT MAX(snap_tmstm)
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D
    WHERE bus_dt_k = t.dt_k
  )
)
SELECT AVG(CAST(clsng_bal_amt AS NUMERIC(20,4))) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM latest_snapshot;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

-- Count distinct current customers with no account transaction in 2025
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM (
  SELECT d.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
  WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND d.IS_ACTV = TRUE
) AS cur_cust
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = cur_cust.CUST_K
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT ddt
    WHERE ddt.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
      AND ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  )
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
    COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
    d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.DCLN_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.DUE_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

-- Total outstanding loan principal on 31‑Dec‑2025 by loan product
-- Assumes PRNCP_AMT is in the reporting currency (no conversion applied).
-- Outstanding = sum(disbursements) – sum(payments) up to the target date.
-- Uses the latest snapshot of the loan product name (DSPLY_NM).

WITH target_date AS (
  SELECT CAST('2025-12-31' AS DATE) AS dt
),

-- Sum of principal disbursed per product up to target date
disb AS (
  SELECT d.LN_PRD_K,
         SUM(d.PRNCP_AMT) AS disb_principal
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  JOIN target_date t ON d.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = t.dt)
  GROUP BY d.LN_PRD_K
),

-- Sum of principal paid per product up to target date
pay AS (
  SELECT r.LN_PRD_K,
         SUM(r.PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS paid_principal
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  JOIN target_date t ON r.BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = t.dt)
  GROUP BY r.LN_PRD_K
)

SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       COALESCE(d.disb_principal,0) - COALESCE(p.paid_principal,0) AS outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN disb d ON d.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
WHERE p.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND p.IS_ACTV = TRUE;

-- Count distinct SME customers who made at least one cross‑border wire transfer in 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d
  ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
  AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
branch_counts AS (
  SELECT b.BR_K,
         b.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM txn_2025 t
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K
  WHERE b.IS_CURR AND b.IS_ACTV
  GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT bc.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bc.region_code ORDER BY bc.atm_txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_counts bc
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
  f.MRCH_CTG_K,
  SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_K
ORDER BY total_txn_amt DESC
LIMIT 3;

-- Top 5 customers by total wire transfer amount in 2025
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    d_ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f_wr_trf.STLM_AMT) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f_wr_trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_wr_trf.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY d_ccy ON f_wr_trf.CCY_K = d_ccy.CCY_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

WITH atm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d_cust.IS_CURR
),
wr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_cust.BUS_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d_cust.IS_CURR
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm
WHERE BUS_ID IN (SELECT BUS_ID FROM wr);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

-- Delete duplicate customer dimension rows, keeping only the current version per business identifier
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        IS_CURR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY IS_CURR DESC, EFF_FRM_DT DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
USING ranked r
WHERE d.CUST_K = r.CUST_K
  AND r.rn > 1;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

-- Insert USD mid rate for 31 December 2025
INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (
    BUS_DT_K,
    CCY_K,
    MID_RT,
    EFF_DT_K,
    EXPRY_DT_K,
    SRC_SYS_CD1,
    SRC_REC_ID,
    INGST_AT,
    UPD_AT
) SELECT
    d.DT_K,
    c.CCY_K,
    1.10::numeric(14,8),
    d.DT_K,
    d.DT_K,
    'POC'::varchar(50),
    'POC'::varchar(100),
    now(),
    now()
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31';

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca';

-- Total wire transfer volume by currency for 2025
-- Assumption: use settled amount (STLM_AMT) as the transfer volume.
-- Assumption: currency is identified via D_CCY.CCY_CD1.
-- Assumption: all business dates in 2025 are included.
SELECT
    c.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
    ch.CHNL_K,
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.CHNL_K, ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction, COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT
    br.BUS_ID AS branch_id,
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON tx.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BUS_ID, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025;

-- Count distinct customers who were in default at the end of August 2025
-- Assumes default is indicated by DFLT_FLG = true in the loan delinquency fact.
-- Uses the latest snapshot date in August 2025 (i.e., the maximum BUS_DT_K for that month).
-- Counts distinct business customer identifiers (BUS_ID) from the current version of D_CUST.

WITH august_snap AS (
    SELECT MAX(bus_dt_k) AS max_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.MTH_NBR = 8
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
default_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K, d.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D fd
    JOIN august_snap a ON fd.BUS_DT_K = a.max_dt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON fd.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
    WHERE fd.DFLT_FLG = TRUE
      AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_default_clients
FROM default_customers;

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  cc.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  cc.CCY_NM AS currency_name,
  AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON rt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc ON rt.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_CD1, cc.CCY_NM
ORDER BY cc.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    d.MTH_NM || ' ' || d.CAL_YR_NBR AS month,
    f.MKT_ID,
    SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.MKT_ID
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR, f.MKT_ID;

-- Delete duplicate customer records, keeping only the current version for each business identifier
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        IS_CURR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY IS_CURR DESC, CUST_K DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
USING ranked r
WHERE d.CUST_K = r.CUST_K
  AND r.rn > 1;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM OPND_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN tx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON tx.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON tx.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

-- Average closing balance on 30 June 2025
-- Using the latest snapshot date in June 2025 from F_ACCT_BAL_D
SELECT
    AVG(abd.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM
    bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS abd
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d ON abd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE
    d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
    AND d.MTH_NBR = 6
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY segment;

-- Count distinct current customers who had no account transaction in 2025
WITH cust_current AS (
    SELECT CUST_K, BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
    txns_2025 AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
        FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
        JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
        WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    )
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM cust_current c
LEFT JOIN txns_2025 t ON c.CUST_K = t.CUST_K
WHERE t.CUST_K IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CMPLT_CTG_K,
       d.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG d
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = d.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CMPLT_CTG_K, d.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

-- Total outstanding loan principal on 31‑Dec‑2025 by loan product
-- Assumes all amounts are in the same reporting currency; if multiple currencies exist, use a base currency column if available.
-- Uses disbursement and repayment facts; sums disbursed principal minus principal paid up to the target date.

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT d.DT_K AS dt_key, d.CAL_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
    WHERE d.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
),
-- Sum of principal disbursed per product up to target date
disb AS (
    SELECT f.LN_PRD_K,
           SUM(f.PRNCP_AMT) AS total_disbursed
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
    JOIN target_date td ON f.BUS_DT_K = td.dt_key
    GROUP BY f.LN_PRD_K
),
-- Sum of principal paid per product up to target date
paid AS (
    SELECT f.LN_PRD_K,
           SUM(f.PRNCP_PAID_AMT) AS total_paid
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT f
    JOIN target_date td ON f.BUS_DT_K = td.dt_key
    GROUP BY f.LN_PRD_K
)
SELECT p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
       COALESCE(d.total_disbursed,0) - COALESCE(p.total_paid,0) AS outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN disb d ON p.LN_PRD_K = d.LN_PRD_K
LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

-- Delete older duplicate customer versions, keeping the current one per business identifier
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        BUS_ID,
        IS_CURR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY IS_CURR DESC, EFF_FRM_DT DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
USING ranked r
WHERE d.CUST_K = r.CUST_K
  AND r.rn > 1;

-- Total wire transfer volume by currency for the year 2025
-- Assumes 2025 is the business year of interest and uses the settled amount (STLM_AMT) as the reporting amount.
-- If a different amount column is required, adjust accordingly.
SELECT
    cc.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY cc
  ON f.CCY_K = cc.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cc.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
